key_insight: DemoPSD replaces full teacher imitation with a disagreement-adapted reverse-KL barycenter, so the student learns from the teacher without copying privileged shortcuts.
engineering_relevance: For LLM training, this offers a practical way to improve reasoning robustness and out-of-distribution generalization while reducing leakage from teacher-only information.
method: Compute the teacher–student distribution gap at each token.
Use the gap to adaptively blend teacher and student into a reverse-KL barycenter target.
Train with selective guidance to preserve exploration and attenuate privileged information leakage.
evidence_signal: The method was evaluated on SciKnowEval across four scientific domains and reportedly outperformed GRPO and SDPO while maintaining higher training entropy and better GPQA out-of-distribution generalization.
watch_item: Adaptive token-level blending may be sensitive to how disagreement is measured and tuned, so stable implementation and hyperparameter selection are likely important.
